brief:
An Iranian shopkeeper has gone viral on social media for his striking resemblance to Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, according to Al Jazeera English. The Tehran merchant has drawn widespread attention online, with users commenting on the physical similarities between him and the Israeli leader.

The unexpected social media phenomenon has made the shopkeeper an unlikely internet celebrity in Iran, where Netanyahu remains a polarizing and frequently criticized figure in political discourse.
dek: A shopkeeper in Tehran has become an unlikely social media sensation because of his striking resemblance to Netanyahu.
title: Iranian shopkeeper becomes social media sensation resembling Netanyahu
